result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical content/data bug showing invalid delivery pricing, and a minor layout clip on a restaurant name.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed number format or missing price value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee data binding/formatting so a valid amount (or a fallback like 'Free' / '—') is always shown instead of NaN.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the Fastest near you card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure enough card width so the full name is readable.
